scope: Ten-package PR; Kubernetes 1.31-1.35 and five utility packages on both architectures.
limitations: Filtered conformance; Serial, Disruptive, Slow, and Garbage-collector categories excluded by the unchanged runner.
Collector forwarding used loopback OTLP with a temporary plaintext exporter; external TLS not exercised.
No live Roles Anywhere session or hardware-backed signer.
validation_notes: Reused the two verified kit archives for the unchanged package tree. All accepted images and runtime runs are fresh.
Conformance images used the recorded consumer commit plus the exact verified refreshed dependency lock; every other tracked source file was checked against the commit.
Initial aws-dev inventories lacked the collector. The test variant was corrected and only the two utility images were rebuilt.
The existing final review was not repeated. Combined-kit/RPM checks remain the disclosed substitute for individual package build jobs.
